profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This CoreSite facility is in one of the company confirmed operating markets. Wikipedia coverage states that as of June 2022 CoreSite operated 27 data center facilities across 10 markets totaling over 4.6 million net rentable square feet, with key locations including Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, New York City, Northern Virginia, San Francisco/San Jose, Santa Clara, Atlanta, Orlando, and Washington, D.C. In May 2007 the company acquired Chicago properties as part of a wider expansion. CoreSite began operating a Washington, D.C. facility in August 2005, one of its earliest East Coast sites after founding in 2001 as CRG West. CoreSite rebranded from CRG West to CoreSite in June 2009, went public in September 2010, and was acquired by American Tower in December 2021. This specific market was confirmed as an active CoreSite location, but no market specific acquisition date or building history beyond the general company timeline was located in available sourcing this session.

reading.body:
CoreSite CH2 occupies 168,000 square feet in Chicago's South Loop. The facility's IT load is not published, so its capacity in racks or accelerators cannot be calculated. Among Illinois's 44 mapped data center facilities, only 6 publish power specifications, and this campus does not appear in that group.

The facility holds certifications for SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 audits, PCI DSS payment processing, HIPAA healthcare data, ISO 27001 information security, and NIST 800-53 federal standards. These qualifications indicate capability to host regulated workloads across financial, healthcare, and government sectors, not AI-specific infrastructure.

CoreSite operates this facility as part of a portfolio of 27 sites across 10 markets, acquired by American Tower in December 2021. Within Illinois, the campus ranks seventh by published megawatts among facilities the site has reviewed, but the state total of 236 published megawatts across six facilities suggests most capacity in Illinois data centers remains undisclosed. Without published power specifications, this facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data.
